generations.prompt:
Create a completely NEW publication-quality scientific mechanism diagram for an ICML paper. NOT a revision of an existing figure. Style: restrained modern scientific schematic, vector-like crisp flat geometry, white opaque background, dark charcoal typography, muted teal retained algorithms, light gray OUTLINES (white interiors) for removed algorithms, burnt orange experience annotations. No gradients, shadows, textures, large boxes, title banner, decorative icons, 3D, or UI cards. Aim wide 2.7:1 canvas, at least 2400 pixels wide. Sparse labeling, excellent whitespace, readable at 6.75 inches printed width. NO overall title inside the figure. Three subtly separated stages, small bold panel letters and headings.

Exact conceptual story: a tree population turns algorithm elimination into accumulation of design experience; that same population supplies algorithms and experience for the next generation.

LEFT STAGE, heading '(a) Select algorithms'. Draw a compact rooted tree, small open square v_0 above retained teal A. A has three branches: A→b_1→b_2→b_3→B, side twig b_2→x; A→s_1→s_2→s_3→s_4; A→C. Retained A,B,C filled teal circles with white letters. Removed b_1,b_2,b_3,x,s_1,s_2,s_3,s_4 are smaller white circles with light-gray outlines and charcoal labels. Thin dark directed edges. Lay the two long chains horizontally or gently downward so the wide figure remains shallow. Enclose ONLY b_1,b_2,b_3,x in a thin orange dashed contour, labeled 'Path region'. Enclose ONLY s_1,s_2,s_3,s_4 in a second separate thin orange dashed contour, labeled 'Subtree region'. A,B,C and v_0 must remain OUTSIDE these contours. No duplicate nodes, no crossing structural edges.

MIDDLE STAGE heading '(b) Accumulate experience'. A small process arrow from stage a to b is labeled 'Elimination + reflection'. Under it use two very short stacked phrases 'Code changes and outcomes' and '+ existing experience'. Draw the resulting retained tree exactly v_0→A, A→B, A→C. A,B,C teal circles. Put a small orange annotation E_AB ON the A→B edge, and a small orange annotation E_A attached to A with a short leader. Math subscripts clear. Under this tree two compact orange-label lines 'Path → edge experience' and 'Subtree → node experience'. Experience annotations should be clean pill outlines, not large panels. The diagram should visually show eliminated code represented by experience attached to retained tree.

RIGHT STAGE heading '(c) Reuse in generation'. A thin orange information arrow from experience-bearing tree in b to a compact three-line typography block with exact labels:
'Refine   Evolutionary path'
'Crossover   Two ancestral branches'
'Explore   Population designs'
Under the block, a thin dark arrow to small unobtrusive label 'Generate and evaluate', then draw ONLY retained teal B→new navy N. Label N 'New algorithm'. This structural edge has exactly one parent B. A small single line beneath stage b or c says 'Parent sampling: fitness rank and offspring evaluations'. No formulas or implementation parameters. A thin navy feedback arrow from the new N goes along the bottom margin back to the left stage, labeled 'Update the population'. Do not let it look like a second structural parent of N. At the very bottom a tiny unobtrusive legend: teal circle 'Retained algorithm'; gray outlined circle 'Removed algorithm'; orange outline 'Design experience'. Keep all labels and arrows readable, accurately spell every word. The scientific message and tree before/after are primary; omit any additional prose.

Precisely edit this figure, preserving the complete layout, all words, node identities, paths, dashed regions and panel headings. Make three small scientific-clarity corrections: (1) In middle panel b, move orange E_AB pill onto the center of the slanted A-to-B edge; interrupt that edge at the pill, with clear segments from A to pill and pill to B. It must visibly annotate the edge, not float beside it. (2) Change the bottom blue feedback arrow so its LEFT endpoint ends as a left-pointing arrow in empty bottom-left whitespace below the left tree, NOT pointing into or touching node B or any other node. Retain label Update the population and the connection from N along the bottom. (3) The orange arrow from panel b to panel c must be clearly dashed to indicate contextual information rather than a parent-child edge. Keep the white background, all topology, linework, font sizes, and colors otherwise unchanged. No other edits.

Create a completely NEW scientific mechanism figure for an ICML paper, not a UI/process dashboard. Flat vector-like scientific schematic with white opaque background, fine but clear charcoal arrows, muted teal retained algorithm circles, white circles with light-gray outlines for nodes removed by the upcoming update, burnt orange experience annotations. No gradients, shadows, textures, thick panels, overall title, marketing text, ornamental icons. Wide approximately 2.5:1 layout, at least 2400 pixels wide if possible. Two side-by-side panels with ample whitespace and modest headings, all text readable at 6.75 inches printed width.

This figure explains repeated accumulation: a later reflection reads experience from an earlier simplification plus new development. Be exact about topology.

LEFT PANEL heading '(a) Reusing edge experience'.
Before: A is retained teal circle at far left, G retained teal circle at right. Horizontal path A→D→u_1→u_2→u_3→G. D,u_1,u_2,u_3 are white circles with light-gray outlines, to be removed. The existing A→D edge carries a small orange pill 'E_AD' located on the edge. A thin orange dashed contour encloses EXACTLY D,u_1,u_2,u_3 (four nodes), NOT A or G and NOT the existing E_AD annotation. Label above this path 'Before a later update'.
A downward process arrow in clear whitespace is labeled 'Reflect + contract'. Beside that arrow write two restrained lines 'Existing E_AD' and '+ new development'.
After beneath it: only teal A→teal G remains, with an orange pill 'E_AG' ON the new edge. Label underneath 'Experience from successive path segments'.
Every node identifier appears once per before/after view, never repeated spuriously. This is NOT arithmetic: do not draw an equation E_AG=E_AD+... . The LLM reflection combines them.

RIGHT PANEL heading '(b) Updating node experience'.
Before: retained teal A has a small orange pill 'E_A' attached above by a short orange leader. A→retained teal C is an ordinary short upper branch. A also leads to a lower chain A→y_1→y_2→y_3→y_4, with the four y nodes white circles gray outlines. Draw a thin orange dashed contour around EXACTLY y_1,y_2,y_3,y_4. Exclude A,C and E_A. Label above this tree 'Before a later update'.
A downward process arrow is labeled 'Reflect + prune'. Beside it two restrained lines 'Existing E_A' and '+ new branch outcomes'.
After beneath it: retained teal A→retained teal C remains, A has an orange pill 'Updated E_A' attached above. Label underneath 'Experience from successive branches'.
Use no extra structural edges and no inference that summaries are lossless. At the bottom a single small shared annotation 'Existing experience is an input to each subsequent reflection'. No other text.
The two panels must align and appear balanced, minimal and professionally typeset, with fine panel separators only if necessary. Accurate mathematical subscripts, consistent arrowheads and node sizes. Maintain each before/after correspondence visually.

Refine only the visual style of this scientific diagram to match a restrained ICML mechanism figure. Keep ALL exact text, math labels, nodes, paths, arrows, region outlines, placements, and topology. Use clean modern sans-serif text for headings and annotations instead of the present heavy serif text; keep mathematical variables italic. Remove the two outer rectangular panel borders. Eliminate ALL gradients and texture: white pure background; retained A,C,G solid dark muted teal #157A6E with white mathematical labels; removed nodes white interior with thin gray outlines and charcoal letters. Orange experience pills should be WHITE interior with thin burnt-orange outlines and orange math labels, NOT orange filled glossy pills. Use modest consistent heading sizes and fine charcoal arrows. Keep the two panels aligned; preserve both four-node removed regions exactly and all before/after mappings. No overall title and no additional text. Maintain original aspect ratio and adequate resolution.

superseded_figures.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate ONE publication-grade scientific method figure for Representative-Cover EvoTrace V3, matching a restrained NeurIPS/ICML paper aesthetic. Landscape 16:9, aim 3840 x 2160 native resolution. Pure white background, completely flat vector-like geometry, no gradients, shadows, textures, 3D, icons or marketing captions. Clean sans-serif type, crisp math subscripts. Modest main title "EvoTrace" at top left. Large readable panel titles, body text at least 8 pt when printed 7 inches wide. Three spacious panels with subtle light-gray separators, NOT heavy colored boxes or header bars. Palette: solid muted teal #157A6E representatives; white circles thick teal outline for fork anchors; slate gray #88939F trial nodes; warm orange #E67E22 experience pills and dashed region enclosures; royal blue #1E5ECC generation and reference information; dark slate thin structural arrows. All node labels inside circles in white except E teal on white. Render exact mathematical labels E_A, E_AD with A or AD as subscripts, v0 with subscript 0. Never invent names or wording.

Figure story: select representative cover first, close branching ancestry second; condense only sufficiently large nonskeleton regions into node/edge experience; select and generate using the maintained tree.

(a) "Representative cover & skeleton" occupies left 32%.
At top under heading use two readable text rows:
"Quality-ordered greedy AST cover"
"|R| ≤ K · AST distance ≥ δ"
Then smaller but legible "Choose R, then close LCA(R)".
Draw exact directed tree:
v0 -> A
A -> B1 -> B2 -> B3 -> D
B1 -> X
A -> Y1; Y1 -> Y2; Y2 -> Y3; Y3 -> Y4
A -> E; E -> P; E -> Q; P -> Z.
v0 small unfilled square, no code; A,D,P,Q solid teal circles (representative cover R). E white circle with thick teal outline (fork anchor). B1,B2,B3,X,Y1,Y2,Y3,Y4,Z gray circles.
Spacious layout: v0 and A centered high; long B chain to left with X branching beside B1; Y chain in middle; E fork to right with P and Q below; Z below P. No edges cross, no node repeats within panel. Enclose EXACTLY B1,B2,B3,X in one very pale orange dashed region (A and D strictly outside). Enclose EXACTLY Y1,Y2,Y3,Y4 in separate pale orange dashed region. Label each region "|C| = 4". Beside Z label "< m: deferred". Keep all counts exact.
Below tree a small flat legend: filled teal circle "Representatives R"; teal-outlined white circle "Fork anchors F ∖ R"; gray circle "Non-skeleton trials".
Draw a simple narrow rightward process arrow across panel gap from a to b in unused midheight whitespace.

(b) "Batched reflective simplification" occupies middle 28%.
Exact simplified tree v0 -> A; A -> D; A -> E; E -> P; E -> Q; P -> Z. Same shapes/colors as (a); E must stay hollow, Q not R. Put orange pill "E_AD" directly ON the A -> D edge at its middle, with visible edge segments on both sides. Put orange pill "E_A" attached by a short orange leader to A. D must remain separate from E_AD. Nodes A,D,P,Q solid teal. Z gray and text "< m: deferred".
Below tree three concise readable rows:
"Path region (≥ m) → E_AD"
"Subtree region (≥ m) → E_A"
"< m: deferred · default m = 4"
Experience pills are white with orange outlines, text orange.

(c) "Search over the maintained tree" occupies right 40%.
At top a restrained teal-outline selection box "Select parent in R". Two rows below inside this box: "Representative rank decay" and "× 1 / (1 + n_r)". Just outside small text "n_r: direct evaluations". A TEAL solid information connector from the representative A circle in panel b goes right to the selection box, clearly labelled "Representatives R".
Below selection put "Operator tree views" as an enclosing group with THREE stacked rows with readable text:
"Refine" — "Root-to-parent path"
                       "Local experience + child attempts"
"Crossover" — "P + distant, high-quality Q"
                           "LCA E + both diverging branches"
"Explore" — "Retained population designs"
                        "Node / edge experiences"
A thin connector from selection goes DOWN into this group. The Crossover row has an input port on the left.
A BLUE dashed arrow starts specifically at Q in panel b and ends ONLY at the Crossover row, label "Reference". It is an information input, never a structural parent edge. A separate ORANGE dashed arrow starts specifically at the orange E_A experience pill in panel b and ends at the overall "Operator tree views" group HEADER, label "Experience". Route these two arrows on distinct horizontal levels so they neither intersect nor cover any label or tree edge. Use clear gap space between panels.
Below group draw down arrow to blue-outline box "Generate & evaluate". Below that show a small exact P -> N pair: solid teal P, solid blue N, dark solid arrow P -> N as the ONLY structural edge into N. Put "Evaluated candidate" beside N. Process arrow from generation ends beside this pair, not another parent edge into N.
A clean blue feedback arrow leaves output N, runs in bottom gutter right-to-left, and ends at panel a's tree area. Label it "Insert & maintain tree". Do not connect it as a second structural edge.
Footnote next to legend: "Only R competes for parent and reference selection."
No numerical performance claims. No redundant prose. Absolutely accurate topology and text, high whitespace, visually professional.

Sans-serif text, render E_AD, E_A as E with subscript AD or A; prior E_A similarly. Three panels left to right, subtle light-gray separators, titles can wrap to two lines. (a) "Partition non-skeleton regions".
Show a clearly arranged exact primary-parent tree:
A -> B1 -> B2 -> B3 -> D
B1 -> X
A -> Y1 -> Y2 -> Y3 -> Y4
D -> Z.
A,D teal retained endpoints, all other nine nodes gray. A near upper left; B1,B2,B3 chain across upper middle horizontally toward D on right, with X below B1. A separate four-node Y chain in lower left area connects from A, no crossed edges. Z below D, far outside both regions, clearly attached to D.
Enclose exactly the four gray nodes B1,B2,B3,X in one pale orange dashed region, label "Path region (|C| ≥ m)" in open space inside enclosure. A and D MUST be outside. Show small orange "prior E" pill attached by an orange leader to B2 INSIDE path region.
Enclose exactly the four nodes Y1,Y2,Y3,Y4 in a different pale orange dashed region, label "Subtree region (|C| ≥ m)". It must be visually connected directly to retained baseline A via A -> Y1. Endpoint A outside enclosure.
Attach orange "prior E_A" pill to A by a short orange line, outside both enclosures.
Below gray Z clearly label "|C| < m: deferred".
Below panel text "Default m = 4" and "Each non-skeleton node belongs to one region".
All circles labelled exactly once. Four gray nodes per enclosed region. Short arrows, adequate space.

(b) "Structured region reflection".
Two clean aligned orange-outline blocks, stacked vertically with a wide gap. Upper:
title "Edge reflection"
four evidence lines:
"Endpoint net diff A → D"
"Intermediate steps + side branch X"
"Inherited notes"
"Bounded comparison catalog"
Then a slim orange rightward output arrow to an orange output pill "E_AD".
Lower:
title "Node reflection"
four evidence lines:
"Baseline A"
"Pruned branch diffs & outcomes"
"prior E_A"
"Bounded comparison catalog"
Then a slim orange rightward output arrow to an orange output pill "E_A".
Evidence words MUST be rendered exactly. Outputs belong to their matching block. Smaller brief text below both "Code changes + measured outcomes → experience". Do not invent further machinery or any champion node. If needed wrap long evidence lines naturally at word boundaries, keep font readable.

(c) "Reconnect & preserve carriers".
In upper half draw retained teal A -> D horizontal structural arrow with orange pill "E_AD" placed ON its midpoint. A has an orange pill "updated E_A" attached immediately above with short orange leader. D -> Z directed vertically down to gray Z. Label Z "|C| < m: deferred". Exactly one A, one D, one Z, no extra structural edges.
Lower half has a small neutral-outline readout box titled "Subsequent tree views" and three neat lines "Path", "Branch", "Population".
Two dotted orange arrows start FROM THE EXPERIENCE PILLS (updated E_A and E_AD) and end at this readout box. Route them around nodes and text; neither dotted arrow starts at D or Z.
Below tree, place two compact mapping rows if legible:
"B1, B2, B3, X → E_AD"
"Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4 → E_A"
Don't collide with Z or the readout.
Along bottom a concise shared legend: teal solid circle "Retained skeleton"; gray circle "Non-skeleton trial"; orange pill "Condensed experience".
Small process arrows between panels clearly show a -> b -> c, not structural edges. This figure must convey inherited notes remain attached to their correct topology, the side branch X goes with the path region, and only whole regions with at least m nodes are reflected; Z stays intact. No performance claims. Spacious, crisp, exact, professional.
